questions.en: What is the name of the Lower Saxony city that is home to a clock which measures time with the highest precision using atomic oscillations?

timeline.labelEn: The successor of the Physikalisch-Technische Reichsanstalt is re-founded in Braunschweig (PTB from 1950)
timeline.labelDe: Die Nachfolgerin der Physikalisch-Technischen Reichsanstalt wird in Braunschweig neu gegründet (ab 1950 PTB)

questions.notes: The Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt (PTB) in Braunschweig runs Germany's primary caesium atomic clocks and disseminates the legal time (DCF77).

questions.cardDe: Wo nahm der Kanadier Chris Hadfield 2015 ein bis dato einzigartiges Album auf: im Weltall, in der Antarktis oder im Basislager am Mount Everest?
questions.de: Wo nahm der Kanadier Chris Hadfield sein 2015 erschienenes, bis dato einzigartiges Album auf?
questions.en: Where did the Canadian Chris Hadfield record his album, released in 2015 and unique at the time?
questions.answerEn: In space (on the International Space Station)

timeline.labelEn: Chris Hadfield releases 'Space Sessions: Songs from a Tin Can', recorded on the International Space Station
timeline.labelDe: Chris Hadfield veröffentlicht „Space Sessions: Songs from a Tin Can“, aufgenommen auf der Internationalen Raumstation

questions.notes: The album was released on 31 Oct 2015; the songs were recorded during Hadfield's 2012–13 ISS stay, not in 2015 as the card implies.
